text: SQL Injection is a code injection technique that might destroy your database. The attacker's goal is to entice a web application to generate a logically incorrect SQL query or to run SQL code of the interpreter's choice.

metadata.title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet

text: Cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks enable attackers to inject client-side scripts into web pages viewed by other users. An attacker may use XSS to send a malicious script to an unsuspecting user.

metadata.title: OWASP Cross Site Scripting Prevention Cheat Sheet
